Open Letter To The Pittsburgh Penguins

May 13, 2010 • Janice Cotcher

Dear Pittsburgh Penguins, Despite my love for the Habs, I thought that you would be repeat Stanley Cup champions. Right now my predicted finals match up from two years ago seems more accurate than this year’s. I’m sorry for your loss. [!]Sidney Crosby Love, Janny

Dear Sidney Crosby, I imagine the last thing you wanted was 30 microphones in your face after being eliminated from the playoffs. You rose above your frustration, fought back the tears and graciously answered every question. You are extremely talented and I’m sure there will be many more Stanley Cup rings in your future. [!]Sidney Crosby with an Olympic Gold medal Also, you are seriously adorable. [!]Sidney Crosby sleeping with the Stanley Cup Thinking of what you did accomplish this year might ease the pain. Love, Janny

Dear Marc-Andre Fleury, I wished you could have ended the season knowing you played your best. After the game was over, the look on your face absolutely broke my heart and I wanted to hug you. [!]Marc-Andre Fleury Love, Janny

Dear Mario Lemieux, You are an owner who opened up his home to your young talented players. Even though fame and money came to them so early in life, you helped these young men become disciplined and professional. You’ve created a great legacy for your team. Love, Janny
